text: 👋 Welcome to Mapleleaf, an open network where you pick your own feeds and take your followers with you. We post product news and updates from this account. A short orientation thread: 🧵

Lots of new people here today!

Researchers, introduce yourselves so newcomers can find you.

I'm a soil ecologist working on how drought changes microbes in farmland, and I write a newsletter about it.

🌱🔬 #SciComm
Quiet weekend at the allotment. The last tomatoes are in, the beans are done, and the neighbours' cat has claimed the shed again.

Version 2.14 is live!

Now you can pin up to three feeds to your home screen and reorder them by dragging. Update from your app store today.

Introducing: profile badges

Writers, artists and developers can now link their own website and show it as a verified badge on their profile. Rolling out to everyone this week.
New in beta: the appeals inbox. You can now see the reports you filed and follow what happened to them. Turn on beta features under Settings to try it.
Reminder: my livestream with the documentary director Sam Ortiz is tomorrow at noon Eastern / 9 am Pacific. RSVP below and bring your questions about making films on a tiny budget.

The illustrators on that cartoon clearly love real buildings: every storefront has the right drainpipes, the right signs and even the right fire escapes. Small details that make the city feel lived in.

Announcing Pagekit!

Starting today, anyone can build a small personal page from their posts, with a custom domain and no ads. Free while in beta.
